answer: Streak multipliers at the nectar: each epoch worked consecutively raises payout weight by 0.1x, capped at 3x. The tide rolls in fresh wallets at 1x, so a sybil farming 50 clones earns 50x baseline while one honest 30-epoch streak earns 30x at zero clone overhead. The lagoon of recycled stake resets streaks on transfer, forcing attackers to hold capital idle through washout. Breaking one streak costs 30 epochs of forgone 3x multiplier—roughly 3x the clone payoff, so honest streaks outearn farms. Streaks make identity continuity the scarce asset.
